text:
Situation: Tobramycin is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 539 eachs of the 300 mg/4 mL presentation (35 days on hand) and 354 eachs of the 300 mg/5 mL presentation (24.5 days). Corvale General holds 257 eachs of the 300 mg/4 mL presentation (15.6 days) and 293 eachs of the 300 mg/5 mL presentation (18.3 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list notes Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, to be discontinued as of 2026-07-17 for tobramycin sulfate injection.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses. No shortage exists today, but the Hospira discontinuation removes a historical supplier. Proactive sourcing from suppliers not on the shortage list protects supply continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place initial orders with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC for both presentations; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as backup source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Ascend Laboratories, LLC as additional backup; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
6. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes at next P&T meeting; requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
